name: Cardiovascular Disease Dataset (Mendeley)
known_limitations: Single multispecialty hospital in India; small sample size (1,000 subjects)
Inconsistent landing page metadata (14 features vs 12 features description)
Binary cross-sectional presence/absence label (no specific cardiac condition named, unverified outcome definition)
No shared patient linkage with other hospital modalities

name: NidaanKosha-100k-V1.0 (Eka Care)
known_limitations: Collected from diverse diagnostic facilities across India (100,000 subjects)
Values extracted automatically via vision LLM (Parrotlet) from images/PDFs; contains extraction noise and format variations
No diagnostic disease or CVD outcome labels; unsupervised/reference-range profiling only
All document identifiers randomized to prevent PII; no cross-dataset patient linkage possible
